headline: Yes to all of this. As agents take on more and more long running project work, and you have swarms of agents that parallelize work against a goal, the agent harness and architecture for orchestration will have to evolve. One of the biggest shifts is how those agents collectively share their knowledge, keep track of the tasks, and also coordinate with human users. This in theory is technically straightforward, but there’s a ton of complexity to get right to ensure agents can both get access to the revenant resources without too much or little exposure. There are a lot of lessons to pull from based on how people already do this kind of work together (people share their files, have computers to work with, community in chats and inboxes, and so on). But equally the primitives need to be able to enable this work at a throughput far higher than people, and in a world where agents can much more easily become a vector of security risk. Going to be super fun building out this next generation of how agents operate. Lots of opportunity here both for horizontal and vertical specific approaches to bring this to life.
